anomaly_root_cause: FALSE_ALARM. The previously reported 13,887 'right-hemisphere _R' vertices in lh.BN_Atlas.annot carry stored label value -1 (0xFFFFFFFF = FreeSurfer medial-wall / unassigned). A Python lookup names[lab] with lab=-1 wraps to the LAST color-table entry 'lsOccG_R', producing the misleading name. All 13,887 (lh) / 13,916 (rh) such vertices lie OUTSIDE the cortex mask (medial wall). The 164k label.gii stores the identical value (-1) at these vertices, so annot and GIFTI are fully consistent. No genuine cross-hemisphere parcel assignment exists.
representation_choice: USE_164K_GIFTI_AS_PRIMARY (Workbench-official; values map cleanly to the BN_Atlas_210_LUT). annot and GIFTI are stored-value identical, so the FreeSurfer annot is an equally valid equivalent; overlap must treat value -1 (medial wall) and value 0 (Unknown) as no-label per the medial-wall rule.
